data.name: Pratap
data.gender_notes: Pratap is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'pratapana', which means to 'shatter' or 'dazzle'. It is a name that represents courage, bravery, and valor. It is a name for a king or a warrior, someone who is shining and dazzling in the battlefield. The name Pratap carries the meaning “Shining, Dazzling” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Pratap usually hope their child will grow to embody shining, dazzling and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Pratap belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Shining, Dazzling.”
